description: This file defines utility functions and macros for integrating ucode VM-based scripting within the hostapd project. It includes declaration of functions related to creating, executing, and managing the ucode virtual machine, as well as utility functions for registry management and specific ucode calls like printf, getpid, sha1, and frequency info.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_create_vm
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new ucode virtual machine instance.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_run
methods.description: Runs a ucode script given its filename or script content.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a function call within the ucode VM by filename or function name.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_call
methods.description: Invokes a registered ucode function with a given number of arguments.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_free_vm
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with the ucode virtual machine.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_global_init
methods.description: Initializes a global variable within the ucode VM with a specified name and type.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_add
methods.description: Adds a value to the registry at a specified index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_get
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the registry by index.

methods.name: wpa_ucode_registry_remove
methods.description: Removes a value from the registry at a specified index.

methods.name: uc_wpa_printf
methods.description: A ucode function that wraps printf-like functionality.

methods.name: uc_wpa_getpid
methods.description: A ucode function that returns the process ID.

methods.name: uc_wpa_sha1
methods.description: A ucode function that computes the SHA-1 hash.

methods.name: uc_wpa_freq_info
methods.description: A ucode function that provides frequency information.
